I replied to Pree in a thread in #central-team: the Marrow Agrisupply store was **Pine Crossing**.

I got this from Pree's own June 9 message in #central-team, which Pree can see. In it, Pree said the Pine Crossing morning receiver's appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 the day before had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis replied that they'd check the shift template and have support try to reproduce it. I also told Pree that the channel has no later message saying it was fixed.

I didn't search any channels Pree isn't in, and the reply contains no finance figures.
